messages.content: Independent enterprise predeployment rubric for exact SHA 515785504c3dbb4d68492cd34dd360cce992be21. P means PASS and F means FAIL. Mark F only for a concrete unresolved material defect in that category; do not fail for an explicitly gated future live paid smoke or the fact deployment is the next signed step. Output schema JSON only.

CATEGORY EVIDENCE for exact SHA 515785504c3dbb4d68492cd34dd360cce992be21.
architecture: Existing Next.js/Node/Graph architecture remains. The provider-neutral contract is still capabilities→estimate→prepare→generate→poll→collect→provenance. Higgsfield is one adapter. Existing synchronous FFmpeg/test adapters retain a separate synchronous path. Graph CRITIC, FIXER, INDEPENDENT_VERIFIER and RELEASE stages are unchanged.
security_privacy: Auth code and repository code are unchanged from deployed V8. Credentials use existing AES-256-GCM IntegrationVault, 0600/no-follow key checks, and public projections expose only configured booleans, never credential material. Paid approval endpoint is authenticated, same-origin/CSRF protected by the existing HTTP boundary, tenant membership-bound, and requires owner/admin. Provider output requires credential-free HTTPS, all resolved addresses must be public, the production HTTPS socket is pinned to one validated DNS answer to avoid DNS-rebinding TOCTOU, redirects are manually revalidated, redirects limited, timeout applied, media <=40MiB and supported video MIME only.
supply_chain: package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, Dockerfile, compose.host.yml, auth and deployment trust-root code are unchanged. No new npm dependency; provider adapter uses Node built-ins and existing modules. pnpm audit --prod: no known vulnerabilities.
agent_tool_governance: No automatic social publication. Missing credential fails before submit. Every credit-bearing request requires an authenticated exact-scope spend approval binding job/revision/provider/model/request SHA/prompt SHA/catalog estimate/exact input hashes. Input change invalidates approval. Reference/mascot input fails closed until a reviewed upload transport exists. failed/nsfw and ambiguous submission never trigger blind paid retry.
state_concurrency: Uses existing AtomicRepository transactions and job lease. Durable attempt is stored SUBMISSION_PENDING before POST. If process dies after paid POST but before request_id persistence, recovery blocks as submission unknown rather than resubmit. Once request_id is persisted, restart polls the same id. Crash after output collection verifies stored artifact SHA/provenance and completes Graph without another provider request. recover() excludes AWAITING_SPEND_APPROVAL, BLOCKED and WAITING_EXTERNAL_GENERATION from automatic restart.
evidence_release_integrity: exact clean SHA 515785504c3dbb4d68492cd34dd360cce992be21; browser and FIRMES E2Es report production-source SHA 7deda35e5b0fced97a207b137555b422d7b250bea1751034ebfdb57679f3880c, runtime manifest 5afae8d43b20173b378fb03416aaeb5cb5efc8ed58e32debbbf859db24a0b93a, 1481 files, 0 forbidden entries, 0 external symlinks. Human review/release remains hash-bound.
fail_closed_behavior: Missing provider credential→CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED / provider credential error; references→PROVIDER_REFERENCE_UPLOAD_REQUIRED; ambiguous submission→PROVIDER_SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN; nsfw/failed→blocked and no automatic retry; changed spend scope invalidates approval; unsafe output URL/DNS/redirect/size/MIME rejected. No live paid smoke is claimed.
testing: exact full suite 198 discovered / 197 PASS / 0 FAIL / 1 pre-existing SKIP. Focused V9/core 48/48 PASS. Typecheck and production build PASS. Examples/contracts 13/13 PASS. Production audit clean. Clean exact browser E2E PASS including separate provider status vs Graph percent and explicit spend approval. Clean exact non-test FIRMES completion PASS. Detached exact worktree 38/38 plus typecheck/build/contracts/audit PASS.
operations_recovery: tests prove persisted request_id reuse, duplicate-spend prevention, stale approval invalidation, moderation fail-closed, ambiguous submit fail-closed, crash-after-collection recovery, and unchanged Graph/release recovery. Current deployed V8 baseline is converged and healthy; signed V9 deploy is next.
portability: No provider SDK dependency. Standard Node fetch for Higgsfield API calls and Node https/dns built-ins for pinned media download. Existing React/TypeScript/CSS UI remains responsive; browser mobile checks and reduced-motion regressions pass.
Pre-fix evidence is preserved rather than hidden: first browser fixture route mismatch was repaired test-only; later source review found and fixed DNS-check/download TOCTOU before this exact SHA.
